cohort: Mississippi hospitals that enrolled in the CHAMPS initiative from 2014 to 2019, and the Black and White mother-infant dyads within them.
finding: The CHAMPS program led to significant increases in breastfeeding initiation and exclusivity and decreases in racial inequities in breastfeeding initiation in Mississippi hospitals between 2014 and 2020.
mod_finding: Skin-to-skin rates increased significantly for all dyads, specifically from 31% to 91% after vaginal birth and 20% to 86% after cesarean delivery.
